title: PowerShell Best Practices knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the central goal of PowerShell Best Practices?
options: Trust a display-formatted table as the only reliable representation of an object.
PowerShell Best Practices should be applied with explicit assumptions, a small checkable example, and verification of the result.
Assume the command exists on every operating system and PowerShell edition.
Skip validation because PowerShell automatically makes all external actions safe.
questions.answer_key: PowerShell Best Practices should be applied with explicit assumptions, a small checkable example, and verification of the result.
questions.explanation: The reliable choice is to verify behavior against the concept in PowerShell Best Practices, preserve the distinction between documented expectations and observed output, and consult versioned official documentation when necessary.
